about.title: Inglewood Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Seven people lost their lives in Inglewood traffic collisions in 2025, according to public records, alongside 446 injury crashes across the city. Behind each of those figures is a household in Los Angeles County learning to live around an empty chair. If that is your family right now, you do not need pressure. You may simply need clear information about what California law allows. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, completely separate from any criminal case or police investigation. Standing to file belongs first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, and then to certain dependents and heirs when no one in that first group exists. The claim can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided over time, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Whether the collision happened along Manchester Boulevard, La Brea Avenue, or on a quiet residential block, LawProactive can connect you at no cost with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency. You set the pace.

whyChoose.title: Why Inglewood Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits who has standing in a wrongful death case, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children before moving to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can sort out quickly whether you or another relative should bring the claim.

items.title: The deadline is real, and sometimes shorter
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but when a city, county, or state agency is involved, the window to act is considerably shorter. Connecting early protects your family's ability to choose.

items.title: Losses that go beyond the bills
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial expenses and lost financial support, but also the loss of love, companionship, and guidance your family member gave. The attorneys we connect you with work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My brother was killed crossing Manchester Boulevard in Inglewood and the driver is facing charges. Do we have to wait for the criminal case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution in Los Angeles County, and the two can move forward at the same time. The criminal case is about punishment; the civil claim is about your family's losses. Because the two-year deadline keeps running regardless of the criminal timeline, it is wise to speak with an attorney sooner rather than later.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California gives first priority to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the decedent's children. If none of those people exist, certain dependents and heirs may have standing instead. An attorney can review your family's situation and explain who should be named in the claim and how the recovery is shared.

items.question: What if the fatal crash in Inglewood involved a city vehicle or a poorly maintained public road?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity follow a different, much shorter process than the standard two-year deadline, often requiring a formal claim within months of the death. Missing that step can end the case before it begins. If you suspect a public agency played a role, ask to be connected with an attorney right away so the timing can be checked.
